control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - permit to work records incomplete for P-4102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-4102, HX-4120 and PT-4102 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically transferring hydrocarbon between vessels. P-4102 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 17 May 2017 a planned critical control verification of P-4102, HX-4120 and PT-4102 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment not effective.
